headline: PPG Industries (PPG) Launches AEROVIEW To Let Aircraft Owners Try Paint Schemes Online
summary: PPG Industries (NYSE:PPG) launched the PPG AEROVIEW virtual aircraft painter, a web-based customization tool for business and general aviation customers. The platform allows users to explore and visualize aircraft paint colors and schemes in a digital environment. PPG Industries is a global coatings supplier with a presence across aerospace, automotive and industrial markets. With PPG AEROVIEW, the company is extending its coatings expertise into a digital channel for aircraft owners,...
